description: Implementation of SCTP network server including connection handling, data transmission, and association management.

classes.name: sctp_network_server_impl
classes.description: Main implementation class for SCTP network server handling socket operations, associations, and data transfer.

classes.name: sctp_send_notifier
classes.description: Notifier class responsible for sending data over SCTP and handling connection shutdown.

classes.name: sctp_associaton_context
classes.description: Context structure for managing individual SCTP associations including address and shutdown state.

methods.name: create_and_bind
methods.description: Creates and binds the SCTP socket to specified addresses.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives messages from the SCTP socket, handling data and notifications.

methods.name: handle_socket_shutdown
methods.description: Handles cleanup and shutdown of the socket and associations.

methods.name: handle_data
methods.description: Processes incoming data for a specific association.

methods.name: init_association_with_msg
methods.description: Initializes a new SCTP association with a destination address and payload.

methods.name: handle_notification
methods.description: Processes SCTP notifications such as association changes and shutdown events.

methods.name: handle_sctp_comm_up
methods.description: Handles the event when an SCTP association is established.

methods.name: handle_association_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down a specific SCTP association and logs the cause.

methods.name: handle_sctp_shutdown_comp
methods.description: Completes shutdown of an SCTP association and removes it from tracking.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming SCTP associations on the socket.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on, if available.

methods.name: subscribe_to_broker
methods.description: Subscribes the socket to the IO broker for event handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize an SCTP network server instance.
